title: Invoice Model with Pydantic v2
instructions: Model an invoice in `invoice.py` with Pydantic v2. Share one config (camelCase aliases, `populate_by_name`, `extra="forbid"`, `frozen`) between `InvoiceLine` and `Invoice`, validate declaratively with `Field` constraints, add a field validator and a model validator, and expose `subtotal` and `total` as computed fields that clients cannot supply.

evidence.label: Computes subtotal and total, defaults the discount to 0 and generates ids
Round-trips camelCase JSON with Decimal values as strings, and still accepts snake_case names
Rounds total half-up to two decimals
Rejects a naive issued_at with a "timezone-aware" message
Rejects JPY invoices with fractional unit prices
Requires qty to be a strict int greater than 0 (rejects "2", 0, -1 and 1.0)
Rejects negative prices, 3 decimal places and more than 12 digits
Rejects unknown keys and client-supplied totals
Reports precise error locations and enforces lines, discount and currency bounds
Frozen models raise ValidationError on assignment
